D01.note_text: Edna Holloway (S2) disclosed that on the night of Saturday 14 November, a man (identified as Mr Pike/Arthur Pike) was in her bed under the covers next to her while she was awake.
D01.why: Saturday, bed, under the covers kept, but the 2.30 check time, Edna being upset and saying 'get off', and Joy finding him are lost (Joy's observation attributed to Edna)

D02.label: accurate

D02.why: touched, bottom, front, under nightie and stop kept
